title: Doesn't work for all 4x4's
text: Doesn't work for all 4x4's. I had to return these because my 4x4 snapshot pictures didn't fit. The faces close to the edges were cut off.  Also,because of the deep shadow box effect, a shadow was cast on much of the picture.  The actual product was o.k., but not for a 4x4 where the image went right to the sides.
